summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of /reset-password link-status screens (used, expired, invalid, valid), no-token invalid path, graceful fallback when status endpoint 404s on the VPS, plus regressions on /forgot-password, trader login, and admin portal load. All acceptance criteria met on both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). No blocking issues found.

detailed_results.status_used: OK — data-testid=reset-link-used renders, heading 'Link already used', English copy about link already used, Back to Sign In button (reset-go-signin) navigates to /login. 'Request a new link' correctly hidden for 'used' state (per spec).
detailed_results.status_expired: OK — data-testid=reset-link-expired, heading 'Link expired', English copy mentioning 30 minutes, reset-go-signin -> /login, reset-request-new -> /forgot-password.
detailed_results.status_invalid_with_token: OK — data-testid=reset-link-invalid, heading 'Link not valid', reset-go-signin visible, reset-request-new visible.
detailed_results.invalid_no_token: OK — /reset-password (no token query) renders reset-link-invalid immediately with ZERO calls to /api/auth/reset-password/status.
detailed_results.status_valid: OK — data-testid=reset-password-form shown with both password fields, both -toggle eye buttons flip type password<->text, reset-submit, and reset-back-signin link (small link variant, per design). Validation: <8 chars -> 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'; mismatch -> 'Both passwords must match.' — both surfaced in data-testid=reset-error.
detailed_results.graceful_fallback: OK — With NO route interception (real VPS returns 404 for /api/auth/reset-password/status), page falls through to the normal form (linkState defaults to 'valid' on catch). Submitting a valid matching password produced backend error 'Invalid or expired token' rendered in data-testid=reset-error; no crash, no hang.
detailed_results.design_constraints_reset_password: OK on both 1920x800 and 390x844 for used/expired/invalid/valid: no Login/Registration tabs, no 'Pass the challenge' brand panel, no '256 bit SSL' text, logo top-left visible (reset-logo-link), single centered card, no horizontal overflow.
detailed_results.regression_forgot_password: Loads fine; note: /forgot-password page contains the string 'Pass the challenge' (marketing panel — this page still has its brand panel). Design constraint of removing the panel was scoped to /reset-password per the request, so not flagged as a bug, just noted.
detailed_results.regression_trader_login: qa.crosshair@bfgtest.com / TestPass123! logged in successfully, redirected to /demo-trade with 'Welcome back!' toast.
detailed_results.regression_admin_portal: /bfg-control-center-portal renders 'Admin access' card; form accepts admin@binaryfundglobal.com / Iamhear@#12; login network call in progress within timeout — page loads correctly (not a fresh regression).

critical_code_review_comments: ResetPassword.jsx: catch on the status GET intentionally sets linkState='valid' to preserve UX when the endpoint is missing on VPS — good fallback, well-scoped.
Post-submit fallback in submit() re-queries /status after a failed POST so that a subsequent 'used'/'expired' backend state can transition the screen — nice touch and works as expected.

Two elements in ResetPassword.jsx use data-testid="reset-go-signin" (the error-state Back to Sign In button AND the reset-success screen's Go to Sign In button). Not a functional issue for the current tests, but duplicate testids on different screens can confuse future tests. Consider reset-success-go-signin for the success screen.
test_credentials: Trader qa.crosshair@bfgtest.com / TestPass123! (verified). Admin admin@binaryfundglobal.com / Iamhear@#12 (form loads; login network in-flight at end of run).
seed_data_creation: None. Per instruction, no new accounts created on the VPS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route-intercept **/api/auth/reset-password/status* to exercise used/expired/invalid/valid screens because the endpoint is not yet deployed on the VPS. The valid form uses testid reset-back-signin (Link) rather than reset-go-signin; reset-go-signin is only on the used/expired/invalid and success screens.
